sentences.zh: 真人原声，品质保证。

sentences.en: I've been approaching my health really differently this year.
sentences.zh: 我今年对健康的看法有了很大的转变。

sentences.en: I used to be really focused on maximizing and doing more.
sentences.zh: 我以前真的很执着于自我提升和做更多的事情。

sentences.en: And now I'm just realizing that if I listen to what my body needs, I perform way better.
sentences.zh: 而现在我才意识到，如果我倾听身体的需求，我的表现反而会好得多。

sentences.en: And that's why I am obsessed with my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我迷上了我的 WHOOP 手环。

sentences.en: Truly, you guys, you know I'm such a data and information-driven person.
sentences.zh: 真的，大家伙儿，你们知道我是一个非常依赖数据和信息的人。

sentences.en: And I love opening my WHOOP app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain is correlating with my mood, with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day-to-day.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢打开 WHOOP 应用，看看我的睡眠、压力和身体负荷是如何与我的情绪、跑步表现以及日常状态相关联的。

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit.
sentences.zh: 我绝对算不上什么顶尖运动员，但我确实从中获益匪浅。

sentences.en: And I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body.
sentences.zh: 而且我也真的很喜欢深入了解自己的身体。

sentences.en: And WHOOP also gives me these actionable, personalized insights that have made me more intentional and meant that I make smarter decisions
sentences.zh: WHOOP 还为我提供了切实可行且个性化的见解，这让我更有意识，也意味着我能做出更明智的决定，

sentences.en: day-to-day about what I need rather than just putting my foot on the gas and just going, going, going, going.
sentences.zh: 在日常生活中清楚自己需要什么，而不是一味地踩着油门，只知道拼命往前冲、冲、冲、冲。

sentences.zh: 新会员在订购会员服务之前，可以先通过 30 天免费试用来体验 WHOOP。

sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com 斜杠 psychology，即可免费体验一个月的 WHOOP。

sentences.zh: 有些物品我们恋恋不舍，因为它们能瞬间把我们带回某个特定时刻。

sentences.en: A photo, a piece of clothing, a tiny souvenir from somewhere unforgettable.
sentences.zh: 一张照片、一件衣服、一个来自难忘之地的精致纪念品。

sentences.zh: 在我的新播客《迷人》中，我和萨姆·托德一起探讨那些成为我们生命一部分的记忆、执念和私人珍藏。

sentences.en: From the sublime all the way to the absolutely ridiculous, it's a fascinating deep dive into the keepsakes we hold close and the memories that make them special.
sentences.zh: 从高雅绝伦到荒诞不经，这是一次深入探究那些我们珍视的纪念品以及赋予它们特殊意义的记忆的精彩旅程。

sentences.en: Charmed, with me, Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 《迷人》，我是萨姆·托德。

sentences.zh: 立即在 iHeart 上收听该播客。

sentences.en: And welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《你二十多岁的心理学》，在这个播客中，我们探讨二十多岁时的一些重大生活变化和转型，以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎再次来到本节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world.
sentences.zh: 无论你是新听众还是老听众，无论你身处世界哪个角落。

sentences.en: So amazing to have you here for another episode.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来收听又一期节目。

sentences.en: Today, we're talking about something that I think we all naturally struggle with, especially in our 20s, and that is self-confidence.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要聊一个我认为我们都会自然而然地与之博弈的话题，尤其是在我们二十多岁的时候，那就是自信。

sentences.en: A very lovely listener of the show actually messaged me about her own struggles with self-confidence and self-love.
sentences.zh: 节目的一位可爱听众实际上给我发了私信，谈到了她自己在自信和自爱方面的挣扎。

sentences.en: So this episode is dedicated to her and her wonderful episode idea.
sentences.zh: 所以这期节目献给她以及她提出的这个精彩的节目创意。

sentences.en: Confidence is such a valuable feeling and a valuable attitude to have, but sometimes it can be really hard to believe in ourselves, to believe in our own abilities and our bodies,
sentences.zh: 自信是一种非常宝贵的感觉和态度，但有时我们很难相信自己，很难相信自己的能力和身体，

sentences.en: our appearance, our value to the world.
sentences.zh: 我们的外表，以及我们对世界的价值。

sentences.en: And I think this is especially the case in our 20s, you know, a decade that is defined by confusion, by uncertainty, massive shifts in how we perceive ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我认为尤其是在我们二十多岁的时候更是如此，你知道的，这个十年充满了困惑、不确定性，以及我们对自我认知方式的巨大转变。

sentences.en: You know, there is this very, I think, widespread romanticization or romanticism about our 20s as, you know, our golden years where we are young and free,
sentences.zh: 你知道，社会上对我们二十多岁有一种非常普遍的浪漫化想象，认为这是我们的黄金时代，我们年轻而自由，

sentences.en: we're able to reinvent ourselves and kind of run wild across the world.
sentences.zh: 我们能够重塑自我，在世界上自由驰骋。

sentences.en: But all of those experiences and those expectations, they come hand in hand with a lot of confusion and at times some pretty massive plunges in our confidence and our self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些经历和期望，都伴随着诸多的困惑，有时我们的自信心和自尊心也会遭遇相当惨重的暴跌。

sentences.en: And our confidence, it can be altered by so many factors like comparison to those around us, you know, exploring our identity and sometimes not coming up with the right answers.
sentences.zh: 我们的自信可能会受到诸多因素的改变，比如与周围人的比较，你知道的，探索我们的身份却有时得不到正确的答案。

sentences.en: Maybe your confidence has been damaged by the pressure to have it all figured out.
sentences.zh: 也许你的自信心已经被“必须把一切都搞定”这种压力所破坏。

sentences.en: You know, these financial pressures, failure, rejection, social media, the list is really endless and all of these things can take a massive toll on our self-worth
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这些经济压力、失败、拒绝、社交媒体，清单真的列不完，所有这些事情都会对我们的自我价值造成巨大的打击，

sentences.en: as we kind of attempt to navigate this very strange and confusing chapter.
sentences.zh: 当我们试图在这个非常奇妙且令人困惑的人生阶段摸索前行时。

sentences.en: But I do honestly think that life is too short to not be the most confident version of yourself, to not love yourself more than anyone else can in the world,
sentences.zh: 但我真心觉得，人生苦短，绝不能不做最自信的自己，不能不比世界上任何人都更爱自己，

sentences.en: to not completely embrace every part of you, you know, the good, the bad, the ugly, and just be unafraid of what other people may think.
sentences.zh: 不能不完全拥抱你的每一部分，你知道的，好的、坏的、丑陋的，而且要无所畏惧别人可能会怎么想。

sentences.en: And if you are struggling with a lack of confidence, you know, you are not the only one, that is for sure.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在为缺乏自信而苦恼，你知道的，你绝对不是唯一的一个，那是肯定的。

sentences.en: But also, we can change that.
sentences.zh: 但同时，我们可以改变这一点。

sentences.en: We have the power.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有这种力量。

sentences.en: You know, we all know those people who are able to remain really sure of themselves no matter what, who can walk into a room and captivate it, who are magnetic and self-assured.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们都知道那些无论发生什么都能对自身充满自信的人，他们走进一个房间就能吸引全场目光，他们具有磁场般的吸引力且充满自信。

sentences.en: And you can be that person.
sentences.zh: 而你也可以成为那样的人。

sentences.en: And as we'll explore in this episode, confidence is very much derived from our own self-perception and internal ideas of where we fit in the world.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在这期节目中将要探讨的，自信很大程度上源于我们自身的自我感知以及对我们在世界中定位的内在看法。

sentences.en: And so much of that self-perception is actually within our control.
sentences.zh: 而这种自我感知中的很大一部分实际上是在我们的掌控之中的。

sentences.en: We all want to be confident.
sentences.zh: 我们都想成为自信的人。

sentences.en: You know, the saying goes that confidence is our most attractive feature, but it's also not something that we gain overnight.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，俗话说得好，自信是我们最具魅力的特质，但它也不是我们一夜之间就能获得的。

sentences.en: So in today's episode, we are going to break down the psychology of building up our self-confidence and our self-love, especially in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 所以在今天的节目中，我们将剖析建立自信和自爱的心理学，尤其是在我们二十多岁的时候。

sentences.en: From, you know, the very elements and foundations of confidence to the reasons why we sometimes struggle with loving ourselves.
sentences.zh: 从自信的各个要素和基础，到我们有时难以爱自己的原因。

sentences.en: And finally, some of those everyday habits that we can use to improve our self-confidence.
sentences.zh: 最后，探讨一些我们可以用来提升自信的日常习惯。

sentences.en: There's so much in this episode, so much valuable research, so much valuable psychology.
sentences.zh: 这期节目内容丰富，有太多宝贵的研究，太多有价值的心理学知识。

sentences.en: So let's get into it and get to the bottom of how we can be the most confident versions of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们切入正题，弄清楚我们如何才能成为最自信的自己。

sentences.en: Confidence is a concept I think we all understand or have some idea of, but just to provide a bit of a refresher, essentially, it refers to the feeling or belief that we have
sentences.zh: 自信是一个我想我们都理解或对此有一定概念的概念，但为了温故知新一下，从本质上讲，它指的是我们内心拥有的那种感觉或信念，

sentences.en: in our own self-worth and in our own value.
sentences.zh: 即对我们自身价值和自我价值感的认可。

sentences.en: I think that confidence is a highly subjective experience and it relates to different attributes for different people.
sentences.zh: 我认为自信是一种高度主观的体验，对不同的人来说，它关乎不同的特质。

sentences.en: You know, perhaps when you're listening to me speak about confidence, you're thinking about it as it relates to your appearance or your body or your fashion choices,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，也许当你在听我谈论自信时，你会把它与你的外表、身体或时尚选择联系起来，

sentences.en: but it can also relate to things like your intelligence, how confident you are in your opinions, in your work performance, in your life choices.
sentences.zh: 但它也可以与你的智力、你对自己的观点的自信、你的工作表现、你的人生选择等事情相关联。

sentences.en: Your interpretation is really entirely up to you, but also entirely different from someone else's.
sentences.zh: 你的解读完全取决于你自己，但也完全不同于别人的解读。

sentences.en: Essentially, self-confidence, it stems from self-esteem, which is an entirely and very personal element of our being.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，自信源于自尊，这是我们生命中一个完全且高度个人的元素。

sentences.en: And self-esteem is made up of a number of different factors, like our sense of identity, our sense of belonging, our resilience, the support structures that we have around us
sentences.zh: 而自尊由许多不同的因素组成，比如我们的身份认同感、归属感、韧性、我们周围的支持结构，

sentences.en: and our childhood experiences as well.
sentences.zh: 还有我们的童年经历。

sentences.en: All of these things, they have an impact on, you know, what exactly we may feel insecure about, our self-esteem, and therefore the level of confidence that we're going to have
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都会对我们究竟会对什么感到缺乏安全感、我们的自尊心，以及因此我们在日常生活中拥有的自信水平产生影响。

sentences.en: in our day-to-day lives.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会有不同的自信水平。

sentences.en: Every individual is going to have varying levels of confidence.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，有些人天生就很自信，超过了你知道的任何其他人。

sentences.en: And, you know, there are some people out there who are, you know, very naturally confident, more than, you know, any other person.
sentences.zh: 这背后的确是有原因的。

sentences.en: And there's a reason behind that.
sentences.zh: 我们的自信水平，实际上很大程度上直接与先天与后天之间的这种相互作用保持一致。

sentences.en: Our level of confidence, they're actually very much directly aligned to this interaction between nature and nurture.
sentences.zh: 我想更深入地探讨这一点，因为我觉得它太有趣了。

sentences.en: I want to kind of go into this a little bit more because I think it is so interesting.
sentences.zh: 但本质上，你的自信既来自于生物和遗传因素，比如你的气质，也来自于环境因素，比如你的养育方式、父母对待你的方式，

sentences.en: But essentially, your confidence comes from both biological and genetic factors like your temperament, but also environmental factors like how you were raised or how your parents
sentences.zh: 或者是那些早期的童年经历。

sentences.en: treated you or those early childhood experiences.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们来看两个孩子，以便对这个想法有更多的了解。

sentences.en: So let's consider two children here to kind of shed some more light on this idea.
sentences.zh: 其中一个孩子从小就有一种非常活泼、毫无拘束的气质。

sentences.en: So one of them from childhood has had a really bubbly and uninhibited temperament.
sentences.zh: 他们表现得非常好奇、好问，而且非常直言不讳。

sentences.en: They have shown themselves to be really curious and inquisitive and very vocal.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母或照顾者鼓励他们，肯定他们的感受，肯定他们的观点，允许他们冒险并做真实的自己。

sentences.en: And they had parents or caregivers who encouraged them, who validated their feelings, validated their opinions, allowed them to take risks and be authentic.
sentences.zh: 然后我们再看另一个人。

sentences.en: And then we have this other person.
sentences.zh: 作为一个孩子，他们天性非常安静，

sentences.en: And as a child, they were naturally very quiet.
sentences.zh: 他们更喜欢活在自己的世界里，享受独处的时光。

sentences.en: they preferred to be in their own world and spend time with themselves.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的父母不那么鼓励他们，没有给他们空间和安全感去探索世界、探索自己的兴趣。

sentences.en: And they also had parents who weren't so encouraging, who didn't give them the space and the security to explore the world and to explore their interests.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，也许他们对他们说话很不客气，甚至侮辱他们。

sentences.en: You know, maybe they spoke down to them and insulted them.
sentences.zh: 由于这些因素的组合，由于个性、内在生物学和气质以及环境的这种组合，这两个孩子将成长为完全不同的成年人。

sentences.en: These two children are going to become entirely different adults because of that combination of factors, because of that combination of, you know, personality, of their kind
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果比如第二个孩子的父母一直非常鼓励他们，充满爱意、赞美和学习的机会，也许事情会有所不同，

sentences.en: of internal biology and their temperament and also the environment.
sentences.zh: 但也可能不会。

sentences.en: And you know, if for example that second child's parents had been really encouraging, full of love and compliments and opportunities to learn, maybe things would have
sentences.zh: 有时我们的直觉和气质确实会占据主导地位。

sentences.en: turned out differently, but maybe not.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着你的命运已成定局。

sentences.en: Sometimes our instincts and our temperament really do take over.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会讨论这一点，但有很多绝妙的方法可以培养你自己的自我价值感和自身价值，而不需要外界的认可，或者我猜，

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean that your destiny is sealed.
sentences.zh: 允许别人的意见真正主导你对自己的看法。

sentences.en: And we'll discuss this a bit later, but there are so many amazing ways to nurture your own self-worth and your own value without needing external validation or, I guess,
sentences.zh: 我认为自信和傲慢之间还有一个重要的区别。

sentences.en: allowing others' opinions to really dominate your own opinion of yourself.
sentences.zh: 自信是一种极具吸引力的品质。

sentences.en: I think there is also an important distinction between confidence and arrogance.
sentences.zh: 它是美好的，因为当我们展现出自信和笃定时，我们表明我们尊重自己，我们信任自己的决定和价值，同时我们也对他人持开放态度。

sentences.en: Confidence is a really attractive quality.
sentences.zh: 我们不害怕别人的意见。

sentences.en: it's beautiful because when we display confidence and self-assurance, we demonstrate that we respect ourselves, that we trust our decisions and our worth, but also that we're open
sentences.zh: 我们愿意听取他们的意见，因为我们不怕批评，也不怕获得成为更好的人的机会。

sentences.en: to others.
sentences.zh: 我认为自信之所以如此吸引人和美丽，是因为它包含了自尊与尊重他人之间非常健康的平衡。

sentences.en: We're not afraid of others' opinions.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，傲慢的人通常完全看不到其他人可以带给他们的价值和成长。

sentences.en: We're willing to take on board what they have to say because we aren't afraid of criticism or the opportunity to become a better person.
sentences.zh: 他们坚信自己永远是正确的，坚信自己是将世界凝聚在一起的纽带，坚信每个人都在不断地崇拜他们，

sentences.en: I think confidence, the reason it is so attractive and so beautiful is because it contains that really healthy balance between self-respect and respect for others.
sentences.zh: 因为他们没有缺点，从不犯错。

sentences.en: And in contrast, arrogant people, they're normally absolutely blind to the value and the growth that other people can offer them.
sentences.zh: 由于这种膨胀的自我重要感，和这样的人在一起会让人感到不快。

sentences.en: They're completely firm in their belief that they are always right, that they are the glue that kind of binds the world together, that everyone is constantly admiring them
sentences.zh: 如果你的生活中有一个傲慢的人，无论是同事、朋友还是家庭成员，你可能也会注意到，他们很难就除自己之外的任何事情展开对话，

sentences.en: because they have no faults, they never make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，或者他们的生活，或者进行一场不被他们的观点完全主导的对话。

sentences.en: These people are unpleasant to be around because of this inflated sense of self-importance.
sentences.zh: 他们也非常不妥协且固执。

sentences.en: And if you have an arrogant person in your life, be that, you know, a co-worker, a friend, a family member, you might also notice how difficult it is for them to
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，非常令人不快，这与拥有健康、平衡自信的人截然不同。

sentences.en: have a conversation about anything other than themselves, you know, or their lives, or to have a conversation that isn't completely dominated by their opinion.
sentences.zh: 我不认为那是我们努力想成为的人，对吧？

sentences.en: They're also really uncompromising and stubborn.
sentences.zh: 我们并不想成为那种永远听不进别人意见的人，那种没有足够的自我尊重去意识到别人对他们的评价可能错但也可能对的人。

sentences.en: Like I said, very unpleasant and very different from someone who has a healthy, balanced level of confidence.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们想成为自信坚定的人，我们想展现出对自己的高度信任，同时又不会对周围的人盛气凌人，也不会无法接受反馈。

sentences.en: And I don't think that is the kind of person we're striving to be, right?
sentences.zh: 但即使是我们生活中最自信的人，甚至是我们生活中最傲慢的人，也总是会有不安全感。

sentences.en: We're not striving to be someone who can never take on board others' opinions, who doesn't have enough respect for themselves to realize that other people can say things about them
sentences.zh: 就像自信一样，我想，不安全感也是高度主观的。

sentences.en: and maybe be wrong but also maybe be right.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，前几天我和朋友聊天时谈到一张她的照片，是我们认识的一个人发到网上的，我截了图发给她，对她说：“你这张照片里看起来简直美极了”，因为她确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, we want to be self-assured, we want to display a great deal of trust in ourselves whilst not being overbearing on those around us or unable to take feedback.
sentences.zh: 她看起来棒极了，而她的反应却非常有趣，因为她极其讨厌这张照片。

sentences.en: But even the most confident individuals in our lives, even the most arrogant people in our lives, they're always going to have insecurities.
sentences.zh: 我们注意到并讨厌自己的地方是如此主观，相比于其他人如何看待我们，除了我们对自己外表、能力和特性的个人评估会最终影响我们的自信水平之外，
